description: Create all 8 Resident module view files (.xian templates) for listing, adding, editing, viewing profiles, printing, barangays, reports, and activity logs. Views use existing Handlebars syntax ({{#if}}, {{#each}}, {{#eq}}), Tailwind CSS, and partials (head, sidebar, topbar, footer). Update sidebar partial to add Residents nav menu items.
steps: Create views/residents.xian: main resident list with search bar (input name=search), filters (select for barangay, sex, status), pagination (prev/next buttons), Add Resident button, table (Resident ID, Name, Barangay, Contact, Status) with View/Edit/Archive action buttons.

Create views/residents-add.xian: form with fields (first_name, middle_name, last_name, birthdate, sex select, civil_status select, address textarea, barangay_id select, contact_number, email). Submit button creates resident.
Create views/residents-edit.xian: same form as add, pre-populated with resident data from resident object passed by controller. Submit updates resident.

Create views/residents-profile.xian: resident profile display with resident_id, full name, birthdate, age (calculated), sex, civil_status, address, barangay name, contact, email, status. Include Edit and Print buttons.
Create views/residents-print.xian: print-friendly version of profile (no sidebar/topbar, optimized for print layout, minimal styling).
Create views/barangays.xian: table of barangays with resident count per barangay. Link each barangay name to filter /residents by that barangay.

Create views/reports.xian: report generation page with filters (barangay select, sex select, age range inputs, status select), Report Type radio buttons (All Residents / By Barangay / By Sex / By Age Group), Export as CSV button.
Create views/resident-activities.xian: activity log table (Resident ID/Name, Action, User, Date/Time, Description) with filters (resident search, action type select) and pagination.

Update views/partials/sidebar.xian to add RIMS navigation section with links: Residents, Barangays, Reports, Resident Activity Log. Make visible to all authenticated users (not admin-only). Place after My Profile, before Admin section.
Update views/dashboard.xian to add resident stats cards for Administrator role: Total Residents, Active Residents, Archived Residents, Top 5 Barangays by Resident Count (chart or list).
acceptance_criteria: All 8 view files created with .xian extension in views/ directory
Each view renders without Handlebars syntax errors (test by visiting route in browser)
Sidebar partial includes Residents, Barangays, Reports, Resident Activity Log links
Dashboard includes resident stats cards for admin role
Forms include proper input names matching controller expectations, select dropdowns for enums, date input for birthdate
Search, filter, pagination UI elements present and functional (form submits to controller with correct param names)
verification: GET /residents renders residents.xian with search form, filters, Add button, empty table (no data yet)
GET /residents/add renders residents-add.xian form with all fields, no validation errors
GET /barangays renders barangays.xian table (empty until seed)
GET /reports/residents renders reports.xian with filters and Export button
GET /resident-activities renders resident-activities.xian with empty activity log
Check sidebar.xian includes all 4 new menu items and renders in all views
Check dashboard.xian includes resident stats section for role='Administrator'
findings: All 8 resident view templates successfully created with .xian extension following existing Handlebars patterns. Views include: residents.xian (list with search/filter/pagination), residents-add.xian (form with date/select inputs), residents-edit.xian (pre-populated form), residents-profile.xian (detail display with action buttons), residents-print.xian (print-optimized HTML), barangays.xian (barangay list with resident counts), reports.xian (report generation with multiple filters and export formats), resident-activities.xian (activity log with filters and pagination). Sidebar updated with RIMS section (Residents, Barangays, Reports, Activity Log) placed after My Profile and before Admin section, visible to all authenticated users. Dashboard enhanced with Resident Management stats section showing Total/Active/Archived Residents, Total Barangays, Top 5 Barangays by resident count for Administrator role. All views use Tailwind CSS matching existing patterns, proper Handlebars conditionals {{#if}}/{{#each}}/{{#eq}}, form inputs with correct names (search, barangay_id, sex, civil_status, status, etc.), and include required partials (head, sidebar, topbar, footer).
